provenance.source_org: Karnataka Geographic Information System (KGIS) / Karnataka State Remote Sensing Applications Centre (KSRSAC)
provenance.license: Government of Karnataka / KGIS Portal Terms (needs verification)
provenance.geographic_coverage: Karnataka State (5,929 telemetric rain gauge stations across all districts)
provenance.temporal_coverage: Current monitoring station network (needs verification of snapshot date)
provenance.known_limitations: Contains sensor location coordinates and station identifiers only; does NOT contain historical or real-time precipitation observations or time-series data; raw UUID filename lacks semantic meaning.
provenance.intended_use: Spatial mapping and spatial density evaluation of hydrometeorological monitoring infrastructure in cyclone-prone coastal zones.

provenance.source_org: Karnataka Geographic Information System (KGIS) / KSRSAC / Water Resources Department
provenance.license: Government of Karnataka / KGIS Portal Terms (needs verification)
provenance.geographic_coverage: Karnataka State (26 water level sensor stations, predominantly urban/Bengaluru)
provenance.temporal_coverage: Current monitoring station network (needs verification of snapshot date)
provenance.known_limitations: Very sparse dataset (only 26 stations statewide); stations are located primarily in Bengaluru urban waterways, not along coastal storm surge / river mouth locations; does not contain sensor telemetry readings.
provenance.intended_use: Evaluated as candidate monitoring infrastructure; documented as an infrastructure gap along the coastal belt.

provenance.source_org: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (ORGI)
provenance.license: Census of India Terms of Use (needs verification)
provenance.known_limitations: Compressed collection of 62 individual Excel files (T01-T45, Town Statements, Appendices); 2011 vintage; redundant with state-level release tables if not selectively utilized.
provenance.intended_use: Granular district tables for Dakshina Kannada when specific cross-tabulations (e.g. amenities, slums, detailed commodity manufacturing) are required.

provenance.source_org: Directorate of Census Operations, Karnataka / ORGI
provenance.known_limitations: 362-page unstructured narrative and tabular PDF; automated parsing is fragile compared to native spreadsheets; reflects 2011 administrative boundaries (e.g. before subsequent taluk re-organizations).
provenance.intended_use: Definitive administrative, geographic, physiographic, and hazard background reference for Dakshina Kannada.
